comparison.objective: Hang an IV bag above a patient and a urine drainage bag below them at the correct heights.
comparison.physical_skill: Classifying two bags and hanging them at height, rather than precision impact tooling in recessed inserts.
comparison.success_condition: Each bag is placed on the appropriate stand and relative side of the patient; detailed numeric thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: The central outcome is safe height-dependent bag placement, not contact-loaded fracture and containment.
